summary.name: LangSwitcher
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS menu bar app that fixes text typed in the wrong keyboard layout when you press Shift twice.
keywords: fix text typed in wrong layout
use_cases: Fixing text typed in the wrong keyboard layout
Converting Russian or English text typed by mistake
Correcting bilingual typing errors without retyping
Converting mistyped text in any app on macOS
Keeping typing data offline and private
summary.what_it_does: LangSwitcher converts text typed in the wrong keyboard layout into the intended one. Pressing Shift twice (the default hotkey) or a custom shortcut triggers the conversion. Smart Conversion, called Greedy Line mode, detects where the wrong layout begins so no text selection is needed. Conversion works through clipboard-based replacement in any app and supports English, Russian, German, French and Spanish layouts, auto-detected from system settings. Each conversion is stored in a local SQLite log that can be rated and exported as JSON.
notable: Double Shift hotkey with Smart Conversion that needs no text selection
Fully offline with no analytics, telemetry or network access
Conversion log in local SQLite with JSON export for ML training
Supports 5 layouts: English, Russian, German, French, Spanish
